title: Roberts Consulting Services
description:
RCS is a full-service engineering firm specializing in Construction Materials Testing, Construc
tion Engineering and Inspection (CEI), and QA/QC services, founded in 2013. With over 60 years 
of combined FDOT experience, RCS provides high-quality professional services to clients in road
way and bridge construction projects throughout Central Florida.
